title: Sunflower Punk Duel
description: Two side-by-side illustrations of an androgynous anime character with spiky black hair and sunflower accessories. The figure wears a yellow and black punk outfit with a corset belt, fingerless gloves, thigh-high patterned stockings, and heavy boots, posed dynamically with hands near the face against a solid green background.
prompt: Side-by-side character study of a fierce androgynous anime punk with spiky black hair adorned with large yellow sunflowers and a headband. The character wears a cropped yellow jacket with black floral patterns, a black corset belt with silver buckles, a short yellow skirt, black thigh-high stockings with circular patterns, and heavy yellow combat boots. Dynamic pose with hands up near the face, long black braided tail with sunflower at the end, solid bright green background, clean line art with bold colors and shading.
